question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**hands**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Hands**" fits well as it denotes the part of the body that can perform the action effectively.
 
• The context tells us that in the First Afghan War, the English suffered greatly at the hands of the Afghans and lost respect in proportion.
 
• Other options ("**palms**", "**heart**", "**mind**") do not fit the context of describing the body part that can perform the action.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Historians generally condemn the acquisition of Sindh by the British in strong words. The causes for annexation were deliberately manufactured. Like many episodes in the British conquest of India, the Afghan war is also a tale of bullying tactics and deceit. However, in the instance of the First Afghan War, the English suffered terribly at the **hands **__of the Afghans with a corresponding loss of prestige.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Palms (हथेली): **"Palms" refers to the inner surface of the hands, which does not fit the context of describing the body part that can perform the action.
 
• **Heart (दिल):** "Heart" refers to the organ that pumps blood, which does not fit the context of describing the body part that can perform the action.
 
• **Mind (मन): **"Mind" refers to the element of a person that enables them to be aware, which does not align with describing the body part that can perform the action.
